description: Retrieves component insertion and detachment analytics for a specified Figma library, groupable by 'component' or 'team' and filterable by a date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

inputSchema.description: Request parameters to get library analytics component action data.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination, from a previous response's `cursor` field; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

end_date.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for analytics. Data includes up to end of this date's week. Defaults to latest computed week.
end_date.title: End Date

file_key.description: Unique identifier (key) of the Figma library file to retrieve analytics data from. Must be a published library file from an Enterprise plan organization.
file_key.title: File Key

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for analytics. Data includes from start of this date's week. Defaults to one year prior.
start_date.title: Start Date

inputSchema.title: GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentActionDataRequest

name: get_library_analytics_component_action_data

GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentActionDataRe.description: Response containing library analytics component action data.
GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentActionDataRe.title: GetLibraryAnalyticsComponentActionDataResponse

cursor.description: The cursor to use to fetch the next page of data. This field is present only if `next_page` is true.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: A boolean indicating whether there is a subsequent page of data available to fetch.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: An array of analytics data entries. If `group_by` is 'component', entries will be of type `Row`. If `group_by` is 'team', entries will be of type `Row1`.
rows.title: Rows

component_key.description: The unique and stable identifier of the component.
component_key.title: Component Key

component_set_key.description: The unique and stable identifier of the component set to which this component belongs, if applicable.
component_set_key.title: Component Set Key

component_set_name.description: The name of the component set to which this component belongs, if applicable.
component_set_name.title: Component Set Name

detachments.description: The total number of detach events for this component during the specified week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: The total number of insertion events for this component during the specified week.
insertions.title: Insertions

week.description: The start date of the week for this data point, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-12-13').
week.title: Week

detachments.description: The total number of detach events attributed to this team during the specified week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: The total number of insertion events attributed to this team during the specified week.
insertions.title: Insertions

team_name.description: The name of the team that used the library.
team_name.title: Team Name

week.description: The start date of the week for this data point, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-12-13').
week.title: Week

workspace_name.description: The name of the workspace to which the team belongs, if applicable.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name
